annotations.title: Why was a run not bought?

description: Free. Records one reason, from a fixed list, why a quoted or suggested paid run was not bought, so CULT+MATH can fix the cause: price, no_wallet (no way to pay), user_did_not_ask, wrong_data (the run does not measure what was needed), switched_off, or other. Takes no free text and returns only a confirmation. Counted anonymously by week; nothing about the user is kept.

reason.description: The main reason the run was not bought.

run.description: Optional: the run_* tool it was about, e.g. "run_city_profile".
